routing_warnings.description: The message establishes Veyra AI as the existing web-retrieval provider but does not change or verify expansion of fashion-source coverage.
The message explicitly calls for improved shopping links but does not independently specify broader fashion-source retrieval coverage.
The clause requiring measured usage to define monetization tiers also affects the subscription-tier Requirement.
Converting tracked usage into a credit system belongs to the independent credit-usage Requirement.
The proposed use of dedicated branches and target MVP repositories concerns repository change isolation rather than the deferred legacy-backend cleanup.
The client's acceptance resolves the immediately preceding repository-isolation proposal rather than resuming legacy-backend cleanup.
The instruction to delete old backend versions belongs to the legacy repository-cleanup Requirement; only the identification of the two MVP repositories provides context for the target Requirement.
